name: Battle of Ankara, Timur vs. Bayezid
summary: Timur (Tamerlane) defeats and captures Ottoman Sultan Bayezid I at the Battle of Ankara, putting the Ottoman Empire in crisis for a decade. Timur restores independent Anatolian principalities and returns to Central Asia, dying in 1405. The Ottoman Interregnum (1402–13) temporarily halts Ottoman expansion, giving Byzantine Constantinople a 50-year reprieve.

_quarry.structural_significance: Timur's victory is a historical near-miss, if he had pushed further west, the Ottoman Empire might have collapsed; instead it recovers under Mehmed I; the Timurid cultural renaissance at Samarkand creates Central Asian Islamic civilization's high point.
